create_ManagedAttribute_with_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor that enforces a specific type when setting values on a class
create_ManagedAttribute_without_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor with no type enforcement for flexible attribute access
use_ManagedAttribute_get: use the ManagedAttribute descriptor to retrieve the private attribute value from a Runner or Reducer instance
use_ManagedAttribute_set: use the ManagedAttribute descriptor to set a value on a Runner or Reducer instance with optional type checking
review_ManagedAttribute_descriptor: review the ManagedAttribute class and its descriptor protocol methods for type-safe attribute management
